note: Mostly seasonal: only the 16 water/electric sites in the middle of the park are sold by the night; the rest are seasonal full-hookup lots. Pool, pond with paddleboats, on the Olentangy (Whetstone) River; the riverside sites are primitive tent sites, not RV sites. --Claude
summary: Priced from the operator's rates page and ResNexus: $50 weekday water/electric base, $55 weekends, $60 holiday weekends (unchanged). Changed sewer true -> false (nightly sites are water/electric with a dump station; full hookups are seasonal), sites 240 -> 231 RV sites with 44 ft max; added showers/dump/wifi, ResNexus booking with a standing 2-night minimum. Riverfront question answered: the riverside sites are primitive tent sites. Pin is ~220 m from the nightly rows (40.56686,-82.99388), at the entrance road; left.
flags: Private gate facts: cheapest real RV night $50.00 (ResNexus, every water/electric site, Tuesdays April/June/September 2027 and a Sunday) - at the US$50 line, not over; $55 Fri-Sat. Google Maps: River Bend Family Campground, 4.4 from 278 reviews, (740) 389-5371, riverbendfamilycampground.com. Working website with phone and its own ResNexus engine: presence passes. Good Sam: not stated.

Long-stay test 4 question: the operator's map shows 231 RV sites, of which only the 16 water/electric sites (91W-106W) are offered by the night (7%); the other 215 are 'Seasonal Full Hook Up' lots, and the rules say sites not shown online 'are reserved for seasonal guests'. Counting the ~25 primitive tent sites also sold nightly, 41 of ~256 sites (16%). Under 1 in 10 on RV sites alone - a mostly-seasonal call for AWH.
Standing 2-night minimum: every RV site on ResNexus is sold only for 2+ nights, weekdays included (recorded in booking.min_stay; 2 nights is within the long-stay test 3 line).

Stored note 'riverfront RV sites unconfirmed' resolved: the operator's map puts the four riverside sites (R2, R4, R6, The Cove) in the primitive tent class; the nightly RV rows are mid-park. Waterfront 'not waterfront' stands.
Town: the operator gives the address as 1092 Whetstone River Rd S, Caledonia, OH 43314.
